name: Dial
description: Gives AI agents real phone numbers to send SMS, iMessage and WhatsApp, place and answer AI voice calls, and receive one-time codes, via CLI, SDKs, REST API or hosted MCP.

skills.name: Provision a Phone Number
skills.description: List and purchase phone numbers on your Dial account, including iMessage numbers that can also carry WhatsApp.

skills.name: Send SMS
skills.description: Send SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp and group messages from a Dial number using the CLI, an SDK, MCP or the REST API.

skills.name: Place AI Voice Calls
skills.description: Place outbound AI voice calls with a system prompt, language and voice, or let an AI voice answer inbound calls.

skills.name: Receive SMS Codes
skills.description: Receive inbound SMS such as one-time codes and completed-call transcripts from the account event stream or webhooks.

skills.name: Check iMessage Support
skills.description: Look up whether any phone number in the world can receive iMessage or WhatsApp before deciding how to reach it.
